Synopsis:
Preview of the 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup in Berlin. The US enters as heavy favorites chasing a fifth straight title but faces headwinds with last-minute withdrawals of A'ja Wilson and Kelsey Plum. France (runner-up at Paris 2024 Olympics), Belgium, and Spain are identified as the most credible challengers. Key player storylines highlighted include Dominique Malonga (France), Emma Meesseman (Belgium), and Awa Fam (Spain).
